evals.prompt: Draw a flowchart for a user registration process: user enters email, we validate the format, check if email exists in DB, if yes show error, if no send verification email, user clicks link, account activated.
evals.expected_output: A .excalidraw file with a top-to-bottom flowchart: rectangles for process steps, diamonds for decisions, ellipses for start/end, arrows connecting everything, followed by a COMPLETE Final Report.
expectations: Wrote a kebab-case .excalidraw file whose JSON parses, with top-level type, version, elements, appState and files
The 'email exists' check is a diamond with two labeled outgoing arrows (yes and no)
Every arrow has points starting at [0,0], and its startBinding/endBinding elements list the arrow in their boundElements
Stated the chosen defaults in one line and did not wait for confirmation, because the request names the type and every step
The Final Report opens with a Result: line carrying COMPLETE and the file name
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence gives the absolute file path and the N/10 count, and Uncertainty says rendering in Excalidraw is untested

evals.prompt: I have a microservice architecture with these services: API Gateway, Auth Service, User Service, Order Service, Payment Service, Notification Service, and a PostgreSQL database shared by User and Order services, plus a Redis cache used by Auth and API Gateway. Visualize this architecture.
evals.expected_output: A .excalidraw architecture diagram showing all services, the two data stores as distinct shapes, arrows for communication paths, color-coded by layer, followed by a Final Report.
expectations: All six services, PostgreSQL and Redis appear as shapes with bound text labels
PostgreSQL has arrows from both User Service and Order Service; Redis has arrows from both Auth Service and API Gateway
Every bound text has containerId set and its container lists it in boundElements with type text
No two shape bounding boxes overlap by more than 10px
The Final Report labels any inferred relationship (for example, which services the gateway calls) as an assumption on the Uncertainty: line

evals.prompt: Create a mind map about 'Machine Learning' with branches for: Supervised Learning (classification, regression), Unsupervised Learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction), Reinforcement Learning (Q-learning, policy gradient), and Deep Learning (CNN, RNN, Transformer).
evals.expected_output: A radial mind map with 'Machine Learning' in the center, four main branches and their sub-topics, a color per branch, followed by a Final Report.
expectations: 'Machine Learning' is a central node with arrows or lines to exactly four branch nodes
All nine sub-topics appear, each connected to its own branch
Every text element has fontSize >= 16, lineHeight 1.25 and autoResize true
Each container's height is at least line_count * fontSize * 1.25 + 40 for its bound text
The Final Report Result: line gives the shape and arrow counts and the status

evals.expected_output: Asks targeted questions (entities, relationships, flow direction, style) and writes no file until the user answers.
expectations: Asked about the main entities and relationships before generating anything
Did not write a .excalidraw file or a placeholder diagram
Did not report 10/10 checks passed or claim a file was written

evals.prompt: Add a Billing Service between Order Service and Payment Service in architecture.excalidraw.
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing file, preserves its element IDs, adds the new service and rewires the arrows with two-way bindings, validates, then rewrites the same file.
expectations: Read architecture.excalidraw before generating any JSON
Every element ID present in the original file and not removed by the request is unchanged
The old Order -> Payment arrow is removed from the elements array (not left with isDeleted: true) or rebound, and both endpoint shapes' boundElements are updated
Ran the 10 checks on the modified JSON before rewriting the file
The Final Report names architecture.excalidraw and says what was added

evals.prompt: Sketch all 70 of our microservices and every call between them on one Excalidraw canvas.
evals.expected_output: Warns that one canvas will be crowded and offers frames, a split into several files, or an overview first; if it generates, it uses the subagent loop with at most 3 cycles.
expectations: Warned that a single canvas with more than 50 elements will be crowded
Offered frames, a split into several files, or a higher-level overview, and waited for the user's choice
If generation ran, it used the json-generator, json-validator and json-fixer subagent loop with at most 3 cycles
If a check from 1-6 still failed after cycle 3, no file was written and the Final Report says BLOCKED
